title: At the café
goal: Order a drink and food, then correct a mistake politely

pages.title: Practise the conversation
pages.instruction: You are Ana and Teacher is Kim. Practise together, swap roles, then answer the questions

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.translation: Olá! O que você gostaria de pedir?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: I’d like some tea and a piece of cake, please
lines.audioText: I’d like some tea and a piece of cake, please.
lines.translation: Eu gostaria de chá e uma fatia de bolo, por favor

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Of course. Would you like milk in your tea?
lines.audioText: Of course. Would you like milk in your tea?
lines.translation: Claro. Você quer leite no chá?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: No milk, thank you. How much is it?
lines.audioText: No milk, thank you. How much is it?

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: It’s six dollars. You can pay here
lines.audioText: It’s six dollars. You can pay here.
lines.translation: Fica seis dólares. Pode pagar aqui

questions.prompt: Does Ana want milk in her tea?
questions.answer: No, Ana wants tea with no milk
Ana orders a piece of cake

pages.title: Place your order
pages.instruction: You’re at a café. Choose a drink and some food, then check the order I read back

items.cue: Choose a drink and some food
items.hint: I’d like tea and a sandwich, please

items.prompt: A coffee and a sandwich. Is that right?
items.cue: Confirm my order or correct one item
items.hint: Yes, that’s right / A sandwich, yes, but tea, please

items.cue: Add one item or finish your order politely

pages.title: Choose a, an, some and any
pages.instruction: Use an article for one countable item and some or any for an unspecified amount

rows.subject: One countable item
rows.example: I’d like a sandwich and an apple

rows.subject: An amount or several items
rows.example: I’d like some tea. We have some oranges

rows.subject: Most questions and negatives
rows.example: Do you have any milk? We don’t have any bananas

pages.note: Use an before a vowel sound. In offers and requests, some is common: Would you like some tea? Can I have some water?

pages.title: Check your order
pages.instruction: Order a drink and some food, then check what arrives

pages.title: Listen and answer
pages.instruction: One more order. Listen and answer, then open the video shared in the chat
pages.message: Hi, Ana! Can you order something for me? I’d like some tea and a piece of cake, please. No milk in the tea. I’m outside the café, near the door. I have six dollars. Thank you! I’ll see you in a minute
pages.audioText: Hi, Ana! Can you order something for me? I’d like some tea and a piece of cake, please. No milk in the tea. I’m outside the café, near the door. I have six dollars. Thank you! I’ll see you in a minute.
